Name: CP - Lighter Default Hair Mask
Author: blkmmb
Description:
I am replacing the default hairstyles with a lighter mask version to help have more accurate colors and brighter overall colors. There is no other modifications and I tried to affect the overall shading the least. This should allow hair colors like blonde to be more possible than default. It is made for Content Patcher.

Check this link for the Fashion Sense Version:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24966]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24966[/url]

Manifest.Name: Lighter Default Hair Mask
